name: Haas lathe
description: Millimetre Haas lathe dialect. Percent-delimited program O00001 with sequence numbers. Diameter mode is the control default. The safety block is G21 G18 G40 G80. Feed per minute is G98 on the following word. G99 is left out, because the IR feed is millimetres per minute and G99 would be millimetres per revolution. Constant surface speed is G50 S max-rpm, then G96 S metres per minute. Direct rpm is G97. The spindle is M3, M4 or M5. The tool word is the tool and offset in two digits (T0101). Arcs are I and K, I a radius. Home is G53 G0 X0, then G53 G0 Z0, in machine coordinates. The program ends with M30 and %. No rotary axis.
